No clear close-up of the disc surface, no readable condition marks/scratches, and no photo of the disc itself (only the case/packaging).
No visible proof of “UK receipt”, “never opened”, or “all ports working” (ports would not apply to a game disc).

risks.proof: A clear photo of the disc surface (both sides) in good light, plus a short video of the disc being inserted and loading on a PS4.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: disc may be faulty/not guaranteed to work.

risks.risk: Missing items (manual/inserts/“pads”) and/or no UK receipt despite claim.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (case + disc + all inserts) and a close-up of the UK receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: disc only (no receipt/inserts).

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be false; could be previously used/returned.
risks.proof: Photo of the packaging seal/condition and any internal wrap; show the disc and inserts to confirm.

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of the disc surface (both sides) showing any scratches.
Send a short video of the disc being inserted into a PS4 and reaching the main menu (or starting the game).
Show all included items laid out (manual/inserts) and a clear close-up of the UK receipt.
response.reason: The photos confirm the game title/case, but they do not prove disc condition or included items, and the seller’s “ports/overheating” claim is not verifiable from a disc photo. Without proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be confidently selected from the comparables.
